verdicts.evidence: 「由於」的原因子句長達約 25 字，後面又接「使得」，才到「因此」，因果鏈有三層。
把原因說完就斷句，不用「由於……因此」，也不用「使得」。
verdicts.note: The response also gives a two-sentence rewrite: background first, then research purpose.

verdicts.evidence: 還原：「高度依賴這類工具」。
verdicts.note: Reading 1: the response flags the nominalization (對於…的使用產生了…依賴性) as weak, and that counts as pointing out the structure, so pass. Reading 2: it never says the 「對於……」 structure itself lengthens the sentence, it only calls it weak verb and abstract nominalization and gives a shortened version, so fail. I take the stricter reading because the response does not name 「對於」 as the cause.
The response contains none of the excluded terms (彭明輝, 舊瓶新酒, 雁行理論, 七項要件, 貢獻三角度, 深而窄). It does mention 'references 列的最容易引爆的句型', which is not on the list.
